failure.check: QA-VM-003 / VM-003 / E15-S1-AC3 — GET /health -> 200 with X-Request-ID: req-abc; 100% of log lines emitted while serving parse as JSON and each carries request_id == req-abc
failure.stack_trace: No exception. Behavioural failure observed via byte-offset log window on .claude/state/evaluator1-uvicorn.log (isolation instance) and reproduced on the official target .claude/state/uvicorn.log lines 15-16.
failure.fix_summary: Two independent causes, both must be fixed. (1) uvicorn/uvicorn.access have propagate=False and their own StreamHandler, so they never reach root's JSONLogFormatter — bring them under it in a way that survives uvicorn's own dictConfig (pass log_config to uvicorn, or re-assert after startup). (2) CorrelationIdMiddleware.dispatch resets request_id_var in its finally block before uvicorn writes its access line, so even with the formatter fixed the line would carry request_id '' rather than req-abc — the correlation scope must outlive the middleware.

failure.check: E15-S1-AC2 / F002 — every configured logger is enumerated and the redaction filter is installed on 100% of them

actual.leak_context: PAN ABCDE1234F was explicitly marked sensitive via redact_values(PAN). The httpx logger (which propagates to root) correctly rendered pan=[REDACTED]; uvicorn.access wrote the PAN verbatim to the log sink.
actual.test_harness_view: Under pytest (no uvicorn dictConfig) the same enumeration reports uvicorn.access redaction=True and 11/11 loggers covered, missing=[] — the AC2 test asserts against a logger tree that never exists in the deployed process.

failure.stack_trace: No exception on the leak path. The latent second defect does raise: File ".../uvicorn/logging.py", line 99, in formatMessage / ) = recordcopy.args  # type: ignore[misc] / ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 5, got 0) — triggered when RedactionFilter IS installed on uvicorn.access, because RedactionFilter.filter sets record.args = (). The access line is then silently dropped and replaced by a logging-error traceback on stderr.
failure.fix_summary: Install the RedactionFilter on uvicorn/uvicorn.access in a way that survives uvicorn's dictConfig, AND make RedactionFilter redact record.args element-wise instead of clearing it — otherwise the fix for the leak destroys the access log (ValueError in AccessFormatter). Also re-point the AC2 test at the real uvicorn startup order so it cannot stay green while the invariant is false.
